{{Quote|We were supposed to go in, wipe out a small band of Rebels and recover some stolen Imperial plans on an encrypted holodisk. Before we knew it, we were nearly overrun by Rebel forces, with the holodisk nowhere to be found...|[[Retired clone trooper|Unnamed 501st stormtrooper]]|<ref name="BF2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>}}
A small [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] '''outpost''' was located on [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]], the main asteroid of the [[Polis Massa Asteroid Field]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The outpost was part of the larger [[Polis Massa Base (Rebel Alliance)|Polis Massa Rebel base]] and was connected to other Rebel facilities on the asteroid via hidden underground tunnels. The Rebel outpost had a sophisticated [[Communications array/Legends|communications array]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

==History==
[[File:BF_Polis_Massa_4.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Members of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] fight soldiers of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the [[Raid on Polis Massa]].]]
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], just prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}}</ref> the facility was home to a Rebel cell which [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] believed the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] were transmitted to. Acting on this information, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Stormtrooper Legion]] [[Raid on Polis Massa|invaded]] the facility and terminated all Rebel troops in the area. Despite this success, the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were not able to recover the plans and were soon dispatched to the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in order to [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|capture]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]'s [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] that was suspected to transport the plans.<ref name="BF2" /> As Imperial forces hastily departed, they destroyed most of the Rebel outpost, including its communications array. The Empire did not realize that this base was just a minor outpost and never discovered the main Rebel facilities on the asteroid. The destroyed outpost was later repurposed into a decoy base, which the Rebels hoped would convince the Empire that the Polis Massa Rebels were defeated. In case of a future attack, the Rebels planed to reveal on purpose other Rebel facilities connected to the abandoned outpost to lure the Imperials away from the major Rebel areas.<ref name="Strongholds" />
